programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Les Moonsliders sont en crise : l'ours Bipol, bloqué du côté « mécontent » de son masque, empêche la fabrication de glaces. Marcus, enrhumé et grognon, doit l'affronter avec l'aide d'Ephi et Gratrok pour gagner un fragment de miroir. Puis, Marcus cache sa peur du bobsleigh, mettant la mission et ses amitiés en danger face à Vipkrad.

programme.title: Grabouillon et le trésor du capitaine Nem'os
programme.desc: Alors qu'il s'apprête à enterrer son os, Grabouillon découvre un coffre au trésor. Malheureusement celui-ci ne contient que des indices incompréhensibles. De plus, les affreux pirates, le Cap'taine Coco et ses acolytes, débarquent sur l'île incognito et veulent eux aussi mettre la main sur le trésor...

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: De pirate à roi Arthur, de Chicago à la banquise, Coda vit mille vies ! Il sauve un marin, enflamme un pirate, arrache Excalibur avant de suivre Arthur à Camelot, croise Al Capone en quête d'alcool pour sa soucoupe, et finit avalé par une baleine en Arctique. Rien ne l'arrête… sauf peut-être la malchance. Survivra-t-il à ce voyage à travers les âges ?

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Encore une fois en rivalité, Lulu et RNS se retrouvent chacun avec une main coincée dans la même boîte... la boîte à secrets de QST qu'ils n'étaient pas censés ouvrir... comment s'en sortir ?La chambre de RNS étant en travaux, Lulu l'invite à dormir chez elle. Mais la cohabitation va se révéler difficile.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon tache le T-shirt préféré de Pétunia, vexé il part à l'aventure mais découvre vite qu'il est plutôt un toutou d'intérieur. Pétunia lui met une collerette contre une allergie, ce qui l'agace. Fasciné par Tatouwak, il cherche un animal totem. Après une pêche ratée avec ses amis, il tente seul le gros poisson, mais la mer est dure.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Les jumeaux Belotte et Rebelotte se disputent et fêtent chacun leur anniversaire séparément, forçant leurs amis à choisir leur camp. Pendant ce temps, Ni-Oui et Blaise se promènent en forêt. Blaise disparaît soudainement et revient une heure plus tard, silencieux. Lulu et ses amis cherchent à découvrir où il est allé et ce qu'il cache, pendant que les Belottes tentent de le distraire.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon obtient son permis de trottinette mais cause un accident avec Pétunia. Il tente de se débarrasser d'un nain de jardin… qui revient avec un copain ! Il part aussi à la chasse à un papillon rare avec Pétunia, piégés par un effet d'optique de Basile. Puis, vexé par son poids, il suit un entraînement intensif… avant que la balance ne traite Pétunia de "poids lourd" à son tour !

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Marcus participe à la grande course de kart d'Atalantis pour gagner un fragment de miroir. Il affronte Vipkrad, le Capitaine Bicrochet, le Roi des Moonsliders et d'autres, avec en plus le nouveau mode déglingo ! Ensuite, à Smalltown, Marcus doit défendre la Mule Express en distribuant le courrier plus vite que la Vipkrad Robotic Post, à la manière d'un vrai cowboy.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu, la tortue intrépide, explore la nature avec ses amis : Rien-Ne-Sert, Belotte, Rebelotte, Frou-Frou, Blaise et Ni-Oui. Ensemble, ils vivent des aventures, découvrent la nature et apprennent la vie en communauté. Le vieux Hibou Qui-Sait-Tout rejoint la bande pour leur ouvrir un nouveau terrain de jeu : la lecture dans son arbre-bibliothèque.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Le Phacochère, amateur de boue, découvre son enclos tout propre. Qui a fait ça ? Hermine essaie de relooker Sherlock, mais son imperméable écossais reste son style. Chihuahua organise un casting pour une pièce sur un détective comme Sherlock. L'Orang-outan, un candidat, se fait éliminer quand un téléphone lui est collé à l'oreille !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon casse une vitre en jouant au tennis et invente une histoire pour cacher la vérité, se déguisant même en oiseau. Lui et Bagout luttent contre un moustique vicieux, avec des résultats comiques. Après une nuit d'horreur à cause d'un hoquet, ses amis tentent de l'aider. Enfin, une fausse alerte télévisée les pousse à se barricader.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Sybilin confie à Marcus la mission de construire une armure robotique dans les usines de Vipkrad pour récupérer un fragment de miroir. Mais Marcus ignore les conseils de Loumie, qui se retrouve isolée. Parviendra-t-il à réussir sans elle ? Plus tard, Marcus et ses amis, armés de pinceaux magiques, doivent dessiner des éléments pour atteindre un fragment, mais un monstre peint prend vie !

programme.title: Poisson davril
programme.desc: Carly et Spencer évoquent les événements du passé, alors qu'ils sont sur le point d'être renvoyés le jour du Poisson d'avril.

programme.title: Pear Store
programme.desc: Freddie obtient un emploi dans un magasin Pear, mais Sam obtient le même poste.

programme.title: Demilloween
programme.desc: iCarly célèbre Demilloween, un nouvel événement inventé par Carly quand elle annonce la tenue d'une fête!

programme.title: Chip la terreur
programme.desc: Spencer se bat contre le frère de Chuck, Chip.

programme.title: Banni
programme.desc: Les intrusions intempestives de Ti-bo dans l'appartement de Spencer et de Carly agacent cette dernière au point qu'elle lui en interdit l'accès. Le voilà banni des lieux ! Pour se venger, il en fait de même avec Carly et la bannit du Smoothie Groovy.

programme.title: Jai perdu ma tête à Vegas
programme.desc: La mère de Sam a été arrêtée à Las Vegas. Sam va devoir trouver deux mille cinq cent dollars pour payer la caution. Toute l'équipe part donc pour Vegas.

programme.title: Sauvez Carly
programme.desc: Sam retrouve Dana, une amie qui vient de sortir de prison. Elle présente Carly à cette amie, qui l'invite à une fête. Carly se rend à cette fête, mais les relations avec Dana restent difficiles du fait de leur caractère.

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: Des amis pour Spencer
programme.desc: En faisant la liste des invités pour l'anniversaire de Spencer, Carly et ses amis se rendent compte qu'il n'a pas d'amis de son âge. Ils se donnent alors pour mission de lui en trouver.

programme.title: Le vol
programme.desc: Sam a perdu son ordinateur portable. Carly et Freddie tentent de l'aider à le chercher. Spencer retrouve des tickets du Funk E. Fester's et décide de remporter le plus gros lot, Murray, le dauphin magique.

programme.title: Au revoir -- Première Partie
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Au revoir
programme.desc: Carly doit aller au bal avec son père, mais celui-ci ne peut pas. Elle demande à Spencer de l'accompagner, mais il est malade.

programme.title: Que le spectacle commence
programme.desc: Carly est accusée pour une des sottises de Sam. Madame Briggs leur fait alors organiser les essais pour les nouveaux talents. Avec l'aide de Freddie, ils filment les auditions.

programme.title: Jadore Jack
programme.desc: Carly craque sur un garçon à l'école nommé Jake. Il est cool et sexy. Puisqu'elle l'aime bien, elle l'invite à auditionner sur son site. Malheureusement, elle comprend un peu tard que Jake est le pire chanteur du monde !

programme.title: Tueurs nés
programme.desc: Animateur de reality show, Wayne Gale, s'intéresse à un couple de tueurs en série : Mallory et Mickey Knox. Il les interview dans leur pénitencier. Mais une émeute éclate et le couple de tueurs s'enfuit en prenant le présentateur comme otage...

programme.title: Mack & Rita
programme.desc: Lors de l'enterrement de vie de jeune fille de sa meilleure amie à Palm Springs, Mackenzie Martin, 30 ans, ressort, par magie, sous la forme d'une femme de 70 ans, qu'elle appelle tante Rita.

programme.title: Gotti
programme.desc: Au milieu des années 1980, John Gotti devient le parrain de la famille Gambino, l'une des cinq familles de la mafia italo-américaine de New York. Son fils John Junior assiste à sa montée et à sa chute.

programme.title: Le Combattant
programme.desc: Jem Belcher est né dans la pauvreté, élevé par son grand-père, un ancien boxeur. Désespérant de gagner sa vie et d'honorer l'héritage de son grand-père, il cherche un mentor auprès d'un entraîneur renommé, qui l'entraîne à devenir le plus grand combattant du monde. Inspiré d'une histoire vraie.

programme.title: Rex, chien pompier
programme.desc: Le chien le plus choyé d'Hollywood s'égare lors d'un tournage publicitaire et devient la mascotte d'une caserne de pompiers locale.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Un malin renard utilise son ingéniosité pour tirer profit de trois fermiers faibles d'esprit qui se résolvent à utiliser des tactiques extrêmes pour protéger leurs poulets...

programme.title: Cloudboy
programme.desc: Nila vient d'avoir douze ans, a toujours vécu en ville avec son père. Cet été, il se voit contraint de partir en vacances à la montagne dans le nord de la Suède avec sa mère qu'il ne connait presque pas.

programme.title: Max et ses amis
programme.desc: Max, un garçon de neuf ans, déménage au château de Geroldseck avec sa mère, qui vient d'être embauchée comme infirmière dans une maison de retraite. Apparemment, un voleur astucieux y sévit. La mère de Max est suspectée, ce qui menace de lui faire perdre son emploi.

programme.title: Officer Down
programme.desc: L'inspecteur Callhan s'embourbe dans des histoires louches de petits trafiquants. Alors qu'un de ses « coups » tourne mal, un bon samaritain lui sauve la vie puis disparaît. L'inspecteur décide alors de profiter de cette seconde chance et revient dans le droit chemin. Mais il a une dette, qu'il ne pourra régler en continuant à jouer les flics modèles…

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Après avoir planifié le casse "parfait", Nick Mullins est trahi et laissé pour mort par ses partenaires. Il survit et décide de se tourner vers les personnes qu'il a essayé de voler pour l'aider à se venger.

programme.title: Shadow Wolves
programme.desc: Lorsque des terroristes de l'Etat Islamique commencent à se faufiler à travers la frontière américaine en Arizona, le colonel Branson, chef d'une division secrète de la NSA, alerte les Shadow Wolves pour qu'ils les traquent et les arrêtent.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Dans une société totalitaire née après une pandémie dévastatrice, chaque citoyen doit accepter un contrat lui garantissant vingt ans de sécurité avant une mort programmée. À quelques jours de son échéance, Tala se lance dans un ultime combat pour empêcher sa fille de devenir à son tour prisonnière de ce système impitoyable.

programme.title: Border run
programme.desc: Une reporter américaine à la recherche de son frère disparu se retrouve au cœur d'un trafic humain à la frontière du Mexique.

programme.title: De Guerre Lasse (Marseille)
programme.desc: Alex, fils d'un caïd marseillais, déserte la Légion pour retrouver Katia. À son retour, Marseille est dominée par les Corses et les gangs, menaçant sa famille.

programme.title: Extraordinary Tales
programme.desc: Cinq histoires, cinq ambiances graphiques différentes, grâce auxquelles les artistes ont exprimé au mieux la complexité et la noirceur de l'univers d'Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Taj Mahal
programme.desc: Louise a dix-huit ans lorsque son père doit partir à Bombay pour son travail. En attendant d'emménager dans une maison, la famille est d'abord logée dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace où une attaque terrorriste a lieu.

programme.title: Les évadés de Santiago
programme.desc: Le récit haletant de l'une des plus grandes évasions carcérales de l'Histoire, celle de 49 prisonniers politiques chiliens au crépuscule de la dictature d'Augusto Pinochet.

programme.title: Expire
programme.desc: Un brouillard toxique, le Smog, a recouvert la planète et oblige les hommes à vivre confinés. Mais quand on a quinze ans, comme Juliette, la vraie vie est dehors.

programme.title: Mur
programme.desc: Un soir d'hiver, par un temps de neige, une femme se rend à son travail. L'environnement est hostile, le labeur éreintant. Une fenêtre ne ferme plus : il neige à l‘intérieur... Le lieu de corvée devient espace de découverte.

programme.title: Ce que cache la neige
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a découvert l'infidélité de sa femme, Alexandre, 35 ans, rumine sa colère. Une idée l'obsède : tuer sa femme pour lui faire payer sa traîtrise. A bout, il se rend dans les locaux de la Simile, une société qui pourra l'aider à concrétiser son projet…

programme.title: A rebours
programme.desc: Alors que Sylvie est en retard pour ouvrir l'épicerie dans laquelle elle travaille, deux clients font irruption : Frank, un jeune homme au visage grave que Sylvie semble connaître, et Julie, une jeune femme qui a l'air de traverser une bien mauvaise passe. Une dispute éclate rapidement entre eux ...

programme.title: Voiler la face
programme.desc: Amine est un jeune musulman rigoriste, très amoureux de sa femme, Enora, une jeune convertie. Lorsque sa femme reçoit une amie, qui comme elle, porte le voile intégral, Amine quitte systématiquement l'appartement et ne voit jamais le visage de l'invitée. Jusqu'au jour où les remarques de ses amis éveillent sa jalousie. Le doute s'insinue dans l'esprit d'Amine : qui se cache sous la burqa ?

programme.title: Navire
programme.desc: Des lettres d'amour jamais envoyées. Un navire miniature qui n'a jamais vogué. Des papiers roulés dans ses voiles. La mer tout autour qui laisse émerger une voix.

programme.title: Dolça
programme.desc: Dans un village du Sud de la France, Dolça, une jeune lycéenne, babysitte Sam, un enfant de dix ans avec qui elle a une relation très complice, jusqu'à ce qu'elle entame une liaison avec son père cette liaison va bouleverser sa relation avec l'enfant.

programme.title: Les guerriers
programme.desc: Rongé par ses désirs autant que ses frustrations, Thomas, seize ans, peine à se construire. Si bien qu'il lui est bientôt impossible de contenir cette rage sourde qui l'anime. Mais loin de le détruire, la colère est son premier élan vers la liberté.

programme.title: Féroce
programme.desc: Après avoir été kidnappé dans son appartement, un jeune cadre d'entreprise se réveille en pleine forêt. Il se retrouve alors traqué par un mystérieux chasseur.

programme.title: Time Rodent
programme.desc: Dans un futur lointain où la nuit a dévoré le jour, les habitants d'un monde en mutation accélérée se nourrissent exclusivement de lumière artificielle.

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Il est trentenaire et habite encore chez sa mère. Taciturne et tourmenté, il a définitivement perdu contact avec la réalité. Une nuit, il profite de l'absence de sa mère pour se libérer une fois pour toutes de ses démons intérieurs.

programme.title: Je suis marié
programme.desc: Un pavillon de banlieue. Une Porsche. Des bigoudis. Une cacahuète...

programme.title: Belle gueule
programme.desc: C'est l'été, le sud. Tous les jours, Sarah, seize ans, vend des beignets sur les plages avec son père. Un soir, elle fait la rencontre de Baptiste...

programme.title: Héros
programme.desc: Maxime a 14 ans. Il vit dans un petit village. Adolescent à la carrure ingrate, il peine à trouver grâce aux yeux d'Astrid, la jeune fille de 15 ans dont il est amoureux. Un matin, le village se réveille avec un immense graffiti sur le mur de l'école primaire. Si l'on ignore qui en est l'auteur, on sait tout de même quelle en est la cause : le maire sortant, unique candidat à sa succession, a enrôlé dans sa liste un militant local du front national. Les autorités ouvrent l'enquête tandis que les jeunes cherchent à connaître l'identité de leur héros. maxime voit là une belle occasion d'attirer l'attention d'Astrid.

programme.title: Tout le monde dit je t'aime
programme.desc: Marion quatorze ans, vient de recevoir un mot d'amour de son copain. Elle demande l'avis de sa meilleure amie, Joséphine. Les deux jeunes filles ne sont pas d'accord quant à l'interprétation du mot “Je t‘aime”.

programme.title: Goût bacon
programme.desc: À la suite d'une rumeur lancée à cause de la diffusion d'un snapchat au contenu ambigu, deux amis, Bilal et Adil, se mettent en quête de filles pour sauver leur réputation. Mais le chemin est loin d'être celui qu'ils avaient imaginé…

programme.title: Nocturnes
programme.desc: Tes est en train de sortir de l'anorexie. La remontée à la surface est difficile, le corps est déréglé, ne répond plus de la même manière. Remanger, c'est accepter de lâcher prise, de perdre le contrôle. C'est à la fois reprendre des forces et accepter sa vulnérabilité. Mais le jeu en vaut la chandelle.

programme.title: Petit crabe
programme.desc: Jeanne vit au bord de la mer. Elle est jeune mais amère. Elle travaille à la poissonnerie parce qu'il faut bien...par dépit surement. Elvis à sa vie, son bateau. Ça lui suffit. De temps en temps, peut être plus maintenant que Kevin, son meilleur pote, est parti étudier à Lyon, il va voir Jeanne. Elle l'intrigue, le perturbe. Perturbe son monde...

programme.title: Les enfants de la nuit
programme.desc: Printemps 1944, dans un village reculé. Henriette, 20 ans, vit seule avec son grand-père Charles. Sa mère a rejoint le maquis. Henriette vit une histoire d'amour avec Josef, un jeune soldat allemand.

programme.title: Bourgeons
programme.desc: Chaque matin, c'est le rituel : Camille, une dame de quatre-vingts printemps sort de chez elle en trimbalant deux gros arrosoirs pour s'occuper de son jardin de l'autre côté de la rue.

programme.title: Petit astre
programme.desc: Alexis, 9 ans, va prendre le train tout seul pour la première fois. Au même moment, à des milliers de kilomètres, une sonde spatiale s'apprête à se réveiller.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Dix passagers d'un bus se retrouvent bloqués dans une casse après avoir été chassés de la route par des motards. Pour survivre, ils doivent improviser des armes et avoir le courage de se défendre contre les motards meurtriers.

programme.title: Jurassic Shark
programme.desc: Alors que l'armée s'attend au pire un homme semble avoir la solution.Ce jeune étudiant parviendra t-il à sauver le monde ?

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Jack Quinn, l'un des meilleurs agents spéciaux antiterroristes à la retraite, coule des jours heureux avec sa compagne en attendant leur premier enfant. Jusqu'au jour où la réapparition de Stavros, son ennemi juré, l'oblige à repartir en mission...

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: Les enjeux n'ont jamais été aussi élevés pour la star de l'action Don « The Dragon » Wilson ! Le chasseur de vampires Jack Cutter (Wilson) doit accomplir son destin et détruire les dernières créatures suceuses de sang de la nuit avant qu'un désastre impie ne se produise.

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Gloria est une jeune new-yorkaise sans histoire. Lorsqu'elle perd son travail et que son fiancé la quitte, elle est forcée de retourner dans sa ville natale où elle retrouve Oscar, un ami d'enfance. Au même moment, à Séoul, une créature gigantesque détruit la ville. Gloria découvre que ses actes sont étrangement connectés à cette créature. Tout devient hors de contrôle, et Gloria va devoir comprendre comment sa petite existence peut avoir un effet si colossal à l'autre bout du monde.

programme.title: Cent Jours A Palerme
programme.desc: Au printemps 1982, le général Dalla Chiesa affiche de brillants états de service après avoir réussi à vaincre les Brigades rouges. Alors qu'il pourrait partir à la retraite, satisfait du devoir accompli, et mener une vie paisible aux côtés de sa compagne Emanuela, il accède à un dernier poste. Il accepte la charge de Préfet à Palerme, une ville contrôlée par la Mafia sicilienne. Peu de temps après son arrivée, le député communiste Pio La Torre est éliminé par Cosa Nostra. Révolté par ce crime et la corruption ambiante, Dalla Chiesa sera désormais la bête noire des parrains du crime. Ces derniers sont bien décidés à lui barrer la route. Lino Ventura excelle en justicier sans peur et sans reproches dans ce drame politique inspiré de faits authentiques.

programme.title: The Brass Teapot
programme.desc: Un jeune couple découvre une théière magique qui fait apparaître de l'argent à chaque fois que quelqu'un souffre à ses côtés. Mais le douloureux objet attire bien des convoitises...

programme.title: Rupture
programme.desc: Renee Morgan vit avec son fils de 12 ans dans une banlieue américaine tranquille. Alors qu'elle fait banalement ses courses, elle est violemment kidnappée et se retrouve, 24h plus tard, attachée et interrogée sur sa phobie des araignées dans un laboratoire vide et anonyme. Les scientifiques, plutOt menaçants, lui expliquent que cette phobie pourrait lui permettre d'atteindre le niveau de « rupture » nécessaire à sa mutation…

programme.title: Murder without motive
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie, le film suit Edmund Perry, étudiant brillant promis à un grand avenir. Son destin bascule après une rencontre fatale avec un policier, révélant les tensions entre privilèges, identité et pression sociale.

programme.title: Le guide du célibataire
programme.desc: Une créatrice de contenu doit chroniqueur son célibat avec Jackson, son opposé. Parviendront-ils à s'entendre?

programme.title: L'amour en coffret
programme.desc: Lillian conseille la start-up de Grant, mais son passé amoureux risque de chambouler ses sentiments.

programme.title: À la recherche du bonheur
programme.desc: Amy, infiltrée dans la retraite de Paul, découvre un secret qui la force à choisir entre l'amour et carrière.

programme.title: Needle in a Timestack
programme.desc: Un mari dévoué ne reculera devant rien pour sauver son mariage, détruit par un rival qui voyage dans le temps. Tiré d'une nouvelle écrite par Robert Silverberg.

programme.title: Ce que veulent les femmes
programme.desc: Un directeur de publicité à succès acquiert la capacité d'entendre les pensées des femmes et utilise cela à son avantage pour progresser au travail et gagner le cœur de son nouveau patron.

programme.title: Once
programme.desc: Une comédie Musiqueale moderne sur un Musiqueien des rues et une immigrante et leur semaine pleine de rebondissements à Dublin alors qu'ils écrivent, répètent et enregistrent des chansons qui racontent leur histoire d'amour.

programme.title: Needle in a Timestack
programme.desc: Un mari dévoué ne reculera devant rien pour sauver son mariage, détruit par un rival qui voyage dans le temps. Tiré d'une nouvelle écrite par Robert Silverberg.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: Dans le futur, les humains vivent aux côtés de robots de compagnie, les Mechas. Mais lorsque David, un prototype d'enfant robot, est programmé pour donner un amour inconditionnel, sa famille humaine n'est pas prête à en subir les conséquences.

programme.title: Duels
programme.desc: Un ancien braqueur de banques devenu shérif n'a plus aucun souvenir de son ancienne vie.

programme.title: The 12th Man
programme.desc: Durant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, douze membres de la Résistance embarquent à bord d'un bateau de pêche pour saboter des installations militaires allemandes en mer du Nord. Tous sont capturés et torturés, sauf l'un d'entre eux qui réussit à s'échapper.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time at Christmas
programme.desc: Quelques jours avant Noël, les habitants de la petite ville de Woodridge sont assassinés par un Père Noël et une Mère Noël fous. Alors que les policiers peinent à protéger leurs concitoyens, les meurtres semblent se concentrer autour d'une jeune femme...

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.3
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Le Duel
programme.desc: Un Texas Ranger enquête sur une série de décès inexpliqués dans une ville appelée Helena.

programme.title: L'ultime sacrifice
programme.desc: Basé sur une histoire vraie, l'aviateur William H. Pitsenbarger reçoit la plus haute distinction militaire.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Coup de Foudre: Mode d'Emploi
programme.desc: Werther, un jeune écrivain insouciant et charmant, rencontre Charlotte, l'amour de sa vie. Mais il découvre qu'elle est fiancée. Contre l'avis de son meilleur ami, Werther met son monde sens dessus dessous cultivant l'espoir de conquérir le cœur de sa compagne.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: Lanie est une journaliste télé ambitieuse, convaincue qu'avoir la plus parfaite des coiffures, le plus beau des amants et le plus luxueux des appartements est ce qui rend véritablement heureux...

programme.title: Célibataires ou presque
programme.desc: Trois amis se jurent de demeurer célibataires, ce qui crée des conflits avec la gent féminine... et même entre eux. Daniel voit secrètement une amie du trio, Mikey fait l'impossible pour reconquérir son épouse infidèle. Jason, lui, cumule les aventures d'un soir.

programme.title: WELCOME BACK, MISS MARY
programme.desc: Joey Vitello, un jeune homme de vingt ans sans but, vit toujours chez ses parents au sein de sa famille italo-américaine haute en couleur. Il retrouve Mary O'Callahan, une camarade d'enfance autrefois surnommée Mary la Terrifiante . Celle qui était un vilain petit canard est devenue une beauté irrésistible, de retour dans le quartier après avoir vaincu un cancer. Lorsque Joey découvre que sa guérison est due à un miracle, leur amitié se transforme en romance, et Mary l'initie à la foi. Les nouvelles convictions de Joey bouleversent la foi de sa famille, et le chaos s'installe alors que chacun part à la recherche de son propre miracle.

programme.title: Troppa grazia
programme.desc: Lucia, mère célibataire, lutte pour trouver le bon équilibre entre sa fille adolescente, une histoire d'amour compliquée et sa carrière de géomètre. Son avenir professionnel est compromis lorsqu'elle réalise que la future construction d'un immeuble ambitieux s'avère dangereuse pour l'environnement en raison des cartes topographiques inexactes du conseil municipal.

programme.title: Sous le soleil de Miami
programme.desc: Luther Simmonds, brillant avocat d'affaires, a accepté une affaire importante à Miami afin de pouvoir donner une dernière chance à son histoire d'amour avec Margarita Silva Santos, avocate d'origine cubaine, qui a rompu leurs fiançailles il y a des années parce que sa famille attendait un marié catholique cubain.

programme.title: Vengeance du passé

Son dernier client, Albert, un comptable, est tombé éperdument amoureux de la célèbre Allegra Cole. En guidant Albert vers le bonheur, Hitch rencontre Sara Melas, une journaliste people qui suit Allegra comme une ombre. Pour Hitch, c'est le coup de foudre, mais les conseils qu'il donne aux autres ne lui suffiront pas forcément, d'autant que la journaliste rêve de démasquer le mystérieux conseiller en séduction dont toute la ville parle…

Le seul qu'elle n'a pas réussi à résoudre, c'est son célibat. Lorsque le taux d'audience de son émission faiblit, Abby est obligée d'engager un nouvel animateur soi-disant expert en relations humaines, Mike Chadway. Dans l'émission, celui-ci traite de ce qui plaît vraiment aux hommes. Le choc est rude entre la jeune femme et ce provocateur odieux et macho. Le pire, c'est qu'il fait grimper l'audience et devient incontournable...

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E4
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E11
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E16
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Project Tiger
programme.desc: “Project Tiger” is the largest and most ambitious conservation project in history. Its success is celebrated around the world, but until now the full story has remained hidden. Marking “Project Tiger's” 50th Anniversary this documentary offers intimate wildlife sequences with rare insight into the tigers' personal world and the ancient forests where they thrive, while unique access to never-before-seen undercover footage reveals the shocking truths of multi-national wildlife crime networks. Set against the backdrop of India's extraordinary growth and transformation, this incredible story is told in full for the first time by the people who have lived and breathed the traumas and the triumphs of five decades of tiger conservation in India.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E02
programme.desc: In Bangladesh, the land with the highest density of population in the world (and the highest amount of corruption), the daily struggle to survive is fought everywhere, including the streets. Nowhere do people drive as brutally and recklessly as here. In Bangladesh you drive on the road like others drive with a bumper car: if you need space, you simply ram the car driving next to you. The police only came if there are fatalities. The biggest bottleneck in the transport system is the historical old town of Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a universe of its own, a world of bazaars in which every trade has its own quarter: there are streets of jewelers, sweets makers and fashionable tailors, and the vegetable wholesalers have their warehouses down at the port. The deliveries take place mostly on the river, the Buriganga River, a stinking cesspool. But the sold goods usually leave by land, and the customers also come by the land route – the Nawabpur Road. They generally come in buses or by rickshaw, where too many people are crammed into too little space. The traffic in Dhaka is everyday, normal madness. The film accompanies a rickshaw, a bus and a truck on their dangerous way through the streets of Dhaka and shows how it is possible to survive in what seems to be an incontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S1 E03
programme.desc: The “Adriatic Highway” is one of the most beautiful coastal roads in the world. The “technical masterwork” was built in the 1950s and 60s, at the time of Yugoslavian President Tito. Abounding in curves, the asphalt road stretches from Ankaran in Slovenia to Ulcinj in Montenegro. More than half of the road is in Croatia (659 km) and a quarter in Montenegro (125 km). Shorter segments lead through Slovenia only nine kilometers are in Bosnia and Herzegovina. For all four countries of the former Yugoslavian Federation, the 1,200-kilometer-long highway remains the main thoroughfare of Adriatic tourism. For many travelers, the highway is the absolute dream road. In dizzying heights, it hugs the steep cliffs lining the Adriatic Sea, winds through coves and bays, gardens and stony fields. Wonderful views of the blue sea, green islands, bizarre cliffs and Mediterranean cities and towns are typical of the highway. But with its numerous curves, the dream road also harbors many dangers.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Flower magic in Madeira: The Flower Festival Festa da Flor is the most important event of the year for the people of the Atlantic island. With it they celebrate spring, which is climatically practically all year round here, their island and themselves. The coast formed by lava, centuries-old laurel forests and green steep slopes make Madeira unique. Those who start right at the front of the big parade of the flower festival in the capital Funchal, will have made it. For Isabel Borges this dream has come true. She opens this year's flower parade along the harbour promenade with her festive group. This accolade does not only mean fame and prestige, but also a lot of pressure. Are the self-designed dresses splendid enough? Will the 150 flower children learn the dance steps in time? Will the flowers on the float hold out in the heat? For Isabel, it is now a matter of nerves.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: La Palma: The Greenest of the Canaries
programme.desc: Thundering waterfalls, ancient forests and an impressive volcanic landscape with black beaches: La Palma is a dream island for nature lovers. It is by far the island of the Canary Islands with the most green, almost half of it is covered with forest. But once a year the green island is dominated by the color white. On Rosenmontag (Rose Monday), the inhabitants have for decades been targeting those ancestors who returned from abroad wealthy and ostentatiously demonstrated their wealth with powdered faces. The carnivalistic approach culminates every year in a white chaos, with tons of talcum, flour or paint trickling down the uniformly white dressed islanders. On the Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma's highest mountain at 2,400 meters, stands one of the largest reflecting telescopes in the world. Astrophysicists love the island because it is the perfect place to look into space. Researchers and star lovers look spellbound to Beteigeuze. The giant star is probably in front of a supernova and could become a second moon in the firmament.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world's biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo's dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn't even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Dordogne consists of a visible and an invisible system of flowing water. Caves and basins under the earth's surface store the excess water and return it to the river when it is dry. A perfect management of a precious resource, not invented by humans, but by the complex nature itself. The result is an ever life-giving river.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: It's a dream route leading from the casino metropolis of Las Vegas, to Salt Lake City, the Mormon capital. It is a journey that follows the footsteps of the first settlers: the Mormons. They came to this desert belt of the United States during the second half of the 19th century to escape persecution and in search of the promised land. Some of them founded Las Vegas. Others moved through the canyons and over the mountains of the colossal Colorado Plateau, where they found water and pasture, to establish many small settlements. The landscapes through which they trekked, had and still have, a breathtaking and bizarre majestic beauty. Bryce Canyon, the hogbacks and the Escalante Staircase plateau are dramatic scenes of wonder formed from rock. The Pajute Indians once described Bryce Canyon as: “red rocks standing like men in a basin”.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Berry Naughty

Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Pants On Fire
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Swept Away
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: When Life Gives You Lemons
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Grim Testament About One Snotty Boy
programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Panic Unbearable Legend About Insects

One day Anya's mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can't be of any danger to giants like children!

The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him.
